messages:
Aisha: Big shoutout to @Tom and @Ken for running the bake sale and staying late to square away payments. We beat the target! :tada:
Tom: Couldn't have done it without Carmen's spreadsheet wizardry. Labels + allergy notes = smooth checkout. :sparkles:
Ken: Real team effort. Also props to whoever brought the gluten-free brownies 60a saved a coworker.
Carmen: Happy to help. I uploaded the expense sheet here: https://rbw.example/bsales/2026-03 (internal). Please attach receipts when you can.
Aisha: Extra funds are earmarked for team lunches and a little greenery for the SRE desk. Quick poll: plant :seedling: or extra snacks :cookie:?
SnackBot: Poll created: "Bake sale reward" with choices [seedling, extra_snacks]. Poll closes in 48h.
Nina: Plant please. Also big thanks to Ken for negotiating a better rate with the vendor 44f
Tom: Adding a tiny kudos to @Ken and @Carmen on the kudos board now. :star2:
Carmen: Thanks! Filed a short note with People Ops about volunteer recognition (maybe stickers?).
Aisha: Adding this thread to the weekly kudos roundup. If anyone snapped photos, drop them in #random-media so I can include one.
Sam: Uploaded 3 pics to #random-media just now. :)
